name: steampunk-128
style_block: Top-down 2D game sprite for a steampunk airship/ironclad vessel colony sim, RimWorld-like readability. Detailed flat-shaded 2D game art, crisp edges, slight 3/4 top-down view on raised objects, NOT photorealistic, no blur. Shared material family: dark riveted iron plate (near-black warm greys), aged brass and copper fittings, verdigris patina accents (muted teal-green), warm amber lamp glow, dark oiled wood trim. Light source top-left, strong readable silhouette, subtle darker edge outline, consistent painterly flat shading. No text, no watermark, no drop shadow, object centered, plain solid background.

assets.name: anchor_floor
assets.prompt: Seamless repeating TEXTURE SWATCH, top-down orthographic, filling 100 percent of the canvas — this is a material sample, not an object: dark riveted iron deck plating of a steam vessel, matte, subtle plate seams, small brass rivets at plate corners, gentle wear, very low contrast, completely uniform ambient light, no lamps, no vignette, no frame, no border. Edges must continue the pattern so it tiles perfectly in all directions.

assets.name: anchor_wall
assets.prompt: Seamless horizontally-repeating TEXTURE SWATCH filling 100 percent of the canvas — a material sample, not an object: heavy riveted iron hull wall panels of an ironclad steamship, one horizontal aged-brass trim rail running across the middle, faint verdigris streaks, darker and higher contrast than a deck floor, uniform light, no vignette, no frame, no border, no background. Left and right edges must continue the pattern for perfect horizontal tiling.
